typesense:explore.greeting:
Earlier that day, you were walking in the crowded and bustling town of Cherios. As you walked through the centre, you accidentally bumped into a cloaked figure. When you tried to help pick up her dropped belongings, you caught a quick glimpse under the hood, revealing the true identity of the legendary adventurer and swordsman: Yadama Kiyo herself. Though she remained oblivious to your realization, you quickly handed her things back, played it cool with a casual apology, and parted ways.

As you stared at figure disappear among the crowds, you reflected on the incident. What will you do now?
typesense:explore.name: Female Swordswoman
typesense:explore.title: The Secret Adventurer
